note: Parquet = a per-column-chunk RLE_DICTIONARY page (dedupes identical values, ZSTD-framed). EKBLOOM m9 = one 540 B shared order-0 dictionary per file + a header-less core per value (amortised). zstd-dict = zstd.BuildDict trained on the same records, dictionary bytes amortised. Read cost is p50: EKBLOOM DecodeRecord per value vs. reading the full Parquet column into []string (which includes opening the file).
